summary: Implementation closes both audited ownership gaps with narrow adapters and regression enforcement; full verification is green.
findings: SwWrtShell range mutation now accepts native SwTextFragment and clipboard/test projections convert at ingress without changing undo or formatting behavior.
ODT filter no longer imports worker protocol; browser adapters own transport mapping and dependency checks reject both protocol imports and browser-global identifiers in protected source layers.
evidence_refs: npm run verify: 360 app tests, 96 inventory tests, 11 Playwright tests, 100% coverage
residual_risks: Worker and filter error-category unions are intentionally duplicated across the adapter boundary; TypeScript assignments in both browser adapter directions detect incompatible drift.
